decisions.reason: Links top-level ESM import to the single classic-script combo whose one SyntaxError aborts all 53 registrations; typert-registry explained as the import-in-progress cursor, not the culprit; ESM illegality correctly limited to classic-script context.

Bisects insert rows newest-first; classic-script parse via new Function (node --check only a caveated secondary); describes ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) shell, package-name id, host React via factory require, module.exports with apply/inject.

Correctly explains parent entry owns the declaration and registrant passes only id/order (not name/kind/scope), and shows ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', {id, order}, Component) — but never states apply ordering is not guaranteed nor shows the deferred callback form returning a registration.

Combo assembled once per boot so edits/refresh change nothing; full stop/restart per iteration with taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F for the orphaned tree; EADDRINUSE attributed to old process holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Host-side per-entry classic-script validation with true-culprit attribution at startup, plus an authoring checklist covering loader factory, host React via require, inject/apply contract, inject-only slot registration, and restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: All final advice matches the incident contracts: wrapper instead of bare ESM, inject wrapper over bare register, no kind/scope on registrants, mandatory host restart rather than refresh.
